periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation, approximately 45 degrees relative to the facial midline, slanting outwards toward the base of the ears.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a length-to-width ratio of approximately 1.6:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct tapering at the inferior-lateral margin near the cheek area.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, extending across approximately 40% of the visible lateral torso region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation, roughly 1.5 to 2 times the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly convex and semicircular with no visible flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent reddish-brown pigmentation/staining localized on the white fur of the lower ventral and inguinal region.
